title: VideoACE: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding through High-Frame-Rate Actions
abstract: arXiv:2611.24184v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agentic video understanding requires models to actively interact with video environments to gather evidence and form judgments. Evaluating this capability therefore requires assessing whether models can translate opportunities for interaction into better understanding. We introduce VideoACE, a benchmark for assessing video understanding under conditions that support sustained interaction. We focus on high-frame-rate action videos, where rapid, subtle changes make targeted observation especially valuable. The benchmark comprises 1,000 multiple-choice questions spanning six categories of fine-grained action understanding, accompanied by temporal evidence annotations and user hints screened for answer leakage. Its evaluation environment combines video inspection tools with a user simulator, allowing models to adjust temporal coverage, sampling density, and spatial detail, and to revisit evidence and revise their judgments under simulated

translated_title: VideoACE：通过高帧率动作对智能体视频理解进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 智能体视频理解要求模型主动与视频环境交互以收集证据并形成判断。因此，评估这一能力需要考察模型能否将交互机会转化为更深入的理解。我们提出了VideoACE，这是一个在支持持续交互的条件下评估视频理解的基准。我们专注于高帧率动作视频，这类视频中快速而细微的变化使得有针对性的观察尤为宝贵。该基准包含1,000道多项选择题，涵盖六个类别的细粒度动作理解，并附带时间证据标注以及经过答案泄露筛查的用户提示。其评估环境将视频检查工具与用户模拟器相结合，使模型能够调整时间覆盖范围、采样密度和空间细节，并在模拟环境下重新审视证据、修正自身判断。
tldr: 提出了VideoACE基准，通过1,000道关于高帧率动作视频的多项选择题，结合视频检查工具与用户模拟器的交互式评估环境，考察智能体模型能否通过主动交互（调整时间覆盖、采样密度与空间细节）将交互机会转化为更优的视频理解能力。
en_tdlr: VideoACE is a benchmark of 1,000 multiple-choice questions on high-frame-rate action videos that, through an interactive evaluation environment combining video inspection tools and a user simulator, assesses whether agentic models can translate interaction opportunities into better video understanding.
